---
name: ship-ticket
description: Deliver a Jira ticket end to end. Read it, move it to In Progress, post a start note, implement, test and open a pull request.
---

# Ship a ticket

1. Jira: use the Atlassian MCP. Call getAccessibleAtlassianResources once for the cloudId, then getJiraIssue to read the ticket.
2. Move the ticket to In Progress with getTransitionsForJiraIssue and transitionJiraIssue.
3. Post a start note with addCommentToJiraIssue: what you will change and how you will test it.
4. Implement the change on a branch, run `pnpm test`, and open a pull request.

reply.description: Uploads that fail on a flaky network should retry three times with backoff before showing an error.
